title: Common Mistakes: I seen it, ain't, if I was

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fixed, simple idea that all people of one group are the same
vocabulary.example: It's a stereotype that all Canadians like hockey.
In films, "ain't" is used to make a character sound uneducated.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a way that matches the situation
vocabulary.example: They will think you are rude and treat you accordingly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the tense for finished past actions (saw, went, ate)
the third verb form (seen, gone, eaten); it needs have/has/had or be
vocabulary.note_en: Not used alone after the subject.
vocabulary.example: "Seen" is a past participle: I have seen it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very informal, non-standard for am not / is not / are not (and have not)
vocabulary.meaning_ar: صيغة عامية غير صحيحة لـ isn't / aren't
vocabulary.example: Say "It isn't good", not "It ain't good".

vocabulary.meaning_en: saying the opposite of what you mean to make fun or show anger
vocabulary.example: He was being sarcastic when he said "Great job".

vocabulary.meaning_en: to smile in a proud or unkind way
not real; only in your mind
a rude word for a stupid person

fine_lines.title: I saw it vs I have seen it (not: I seen it)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: saw ماضٍ بسيط ويُستخدم وحده. seen تصريف ثالث يحتاج have/has/had قبله (أو be في المبني للمجهول). لا نقول I seen it.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Saw is simple past and stands alone. Seen is a past participle and needs have/has/had before it (or be in the passive). Never say "I seen it".

examples.sentence: I have seen this movie before.

fine_lines.title: ain't vs isn't / aren't / am not
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ain't صيغة عامية تُستخدم في الأفلام لإظهار شخصية غير متعلمة. الصحيح: I am not / he isn't / they aren't.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Ain't is slang used in films to show an uneducated character. Correct: I am not / he isn't / they aren't.

fine_lines.title: If I was vs If I were
fine_lines.explanation_ar: was تدل على حقيقة حدثت في الماضي. if + would تدل على التخيّل، لذلك نستخدم were مع كل الضمائر: If I were you. تذكّر: if = imagine (يبدأ بحرف i).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Was shows a past fact. If + would shows something imaginary, so use were with all subjects: If I were you. Remember: if = imagine (both start with i).

examples.sentence: If I were you, I wouldn't watch it. (imaginary)

expressions.phrase: If I were you, I would...
expressions.example: If I were you, I would do the lesson again.
I saw that film. It isn't that good.
I saw it with my own two eyes.
His rude words set her off.

grammar.title: Mistake 1: "I seen it"
grammar.explanation_ar: الحل 1: استخدم الماضي البسيط: I saw it. الحل 2: التصريف الثالث يحتاج كلمتين: I have seen it / He has seen it / I had seen it. ويُستخدم أيضًا في المبني للمجهول: It was seen.
grammar.explanation_en: Fix 1: use the simple past: I saw it. Fix 2: the past participle needs two words: I have seen it / He has seen it / I had seen it. It is also used in the passive: It was seen.
examples: The cake was eaten by the kids. (passive)

grammar.title: Mistake 2: "ain't"
grammar.explanation_ar: تعلّم نفي فعل be: I am not (I'm not)، he/she/it is not (isn't)، we/you/they are not (aren't). ain't قد تُستخدم عمدًا للسخرية، لكن تجنّبها.
grammar.explanation_en: Learn the negative of be: I am not (I'm not), he/she/it is not (isn't), we/you/they are not (aren't). Ain't is sometimes used on purpose to be sarcastic, but avoid it.

grammar.title: Mistake 3: "If I was you"
grammar.explanation_ar: في الجمل الافتراضية (if ... would) نستخدم were لكل الضمائر. كثيرون يقولون was في الكلام، لكن were هي الصحيحة رسميًا.
grammar.explanation_en: In imaginary sentences (if ... would) use were for every subject. Many people say was in speech, but were is the correct formal form.
examples: If I were a millionaire, I would help my village.
If she were here, she would know.

questions.question: If I ___ you, I would study more.
A past participle like "seen" needs ___ before it.
What is a "stereotype"?
choices: a fixed idea that all people in a group are the same
questions.explanation_en: A fixed idea that a whole group is the same.

questions.question: Someone who is "sarcastic" ___.
choices: says the opposite of what they mean
questions.explanation_en: A sarcastic person says the opposite of what they mean.
